segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the revised quote for the 42 seats and make sure the May 1 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, May 1 is still the target. We have the operations team ready for training the week before, assuming the contract is wrapped by April 12.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should be fine. The quote is at $38,640 for the annual term, includes the 42 standard seats, the reporting add-on, and two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation fee, I think last time you said $4,500. Is that still in there?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. One-time $4,500, billed on the first invoice with the annual subscription. After that it’s just the renewal amount unless you add seats or change modules.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Billing-wise, can you do net 45? Our finance team asked because the April close is a little tight.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 45 is approved for this quote. I’ll make sure that’s reflected in the order form, along with the April 15 invoice date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On seats, we may add five more in Q3 for the second warehouse. Would those be prorated?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, any added seats are prorated through the end of the current term. So if you add them August 1, they’d be billed for the remaining eight months.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send over the order form today if you can, and I’ll route it to legal. I don’t expect major changes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it this afternoon with the quote summary and the implementation timeline attached.
